panels.English: Did you hear? The princess is getting engaged!
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: Yes, to the duke's son, right?
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: They say her engagement ring cost enough to buy a mountain.
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: That's a duke for you... I wonder when we'll see the princess wearing it.
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: We'll see her in it soon. Other ladies will want one, too.
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: Oh! Once it's in fashion, it'll be too late! Do you know which gem it is?
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: I haven't heard. We'd better go ask!
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: Gemstones may catch on in London.
panels.speaker: Speakerless panel

panels.English: Did you see that brilliant red ruby?
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: Oh? What are you two talking about?
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: The necklace that lady was wearing.
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: Oh, that one! What a beautiful stone. And so big!
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: Just once in my life, I'd love a gentleman to give me something like that.
panels.speaker: Lady

panels.English: Rubies may catch on in Athens.
panels.speaker: Speakerless panel
